back: A fixed set of inputs with expected outputs or criteria, run against a prompt and model before shipping. The unit test suite of an LLM feature.

front: Where should eval examples come from?
back: Sampled, anonymised real traffic, every bug you've fixed, and targeted slices; synthetic examples only as a supplement.

front: 95% interval for a 90% pass rate on 200 examples?
back: SE = √(0.9 × 0.1 / 200) ≈ 2.1 points, so about ±4.2 points. A 2-point change is noise.
Running both prompts on the same examples and examining only the ones that changed outcome removes per-example variation, so smaller differences become detectable.
Position bias, verbosity bias and self-enhancement bias (Zheng et al., 2023).

front: How to control position bias in pairwise judging?
back: Judge each pair in both orders and count a win only when the judge prefers the same answer both times.

front: First step before trusting a judge?
back: Compare it with human labels on a few hundred examples and measure agreement, for example with Cohen's kappa.

front: Binary criteria or a 1–10 scale for a judge?
back: Binary, specific criteria: easier to calibrate, more stable over time, and they map to a fix.
Running the eval set automatically on every prompt or model change and blocking it if any slice drops beyond its threshold.
A floating alias that moves to a new model is an untested deploy of different behaviour.

front: How can an overall eval score hide a regression?
back: A small slice can collapse while the average barely moves. Gate on per-slice thresholds and must-pass examples.
Instructions hidden in content the system fetches (a web page, email or document) that try to override the application's instructions.

front: Why isn't an injection classifier enough?
back: Phrasings are unbounded, so filters leak. Rely on least privilege, untrusted handling of model output and confirmation of side effects.

front: Two ways to filter a streamed answer?
back: Buffer and check each sentence or paragraph before showing it (more latency), or stream and retract on failure (user may glimpse it).

front: Four doors PII leaks through in an LLM feature?
back: Prompts sent to the provider, your logs and traces, eval sets copied from traffic, and answers shown to another user.
Replace personal data with placeholders such as PERSON_1 before the model call, keep the mapping locally, and restore it in the answer.
Regenerate clicks, rephrased questions, copies, abandonment and escalations to a human.

front: How do you close the eval loop?
back: Every confirmed bad production answer becomes a new eval example, so the offline set tracks real usage.
